closureNote: within a seasonal period (three consecutive sampling weeks); populations change between April, July and October and between crops

geographicCoverage.description: Commercial arable plots in Belgium (locations not given in the deposit)

title: Pitfall-trap counts of 70 ground beetle species per trap and sampling week in Belgian sugar beet and winter cereal plots, 2023-2025
abstract: Carabid beetles in 40 commercial arable plots in Belgium followed through a sugar beet - winter cereal succession in two crop cycles (plots 1-20: sugar beet 2023, cereal 2024; plots 21-40: sugar beet 2024, cereal 2025), sampled in April, July and (sugar beet) October, three sampling weeks each. Barber pitfall traps at six within-plot positions, with vinegar, propylene glycol (2023) or brine (2024-2025) as preservative. 3070 collections with status ok; 70 species caught.
samplingProtocol: Barber pitfall traps at fixed positions in each plot (lines A, B, C1, C2, D, E), preservative vinegar, propylene glycol or brine (unit_preservative), emptied after each sampling week; three weeks per seasonal period.
surveyEvidenceNote: The deposited sheet has one row per trap collection with its status (Etat); a survey is a row with Etat = ok (3070 of 3258 pitfall rows). Absent, flooded (Inonde / Inondé), torn (Trouée), removed (Retire) and Vide collections are not surveys. Two rows mistyped as sampling week 2 are read as week 3 from their position in the sheet.

notShipped.collections not ok: 188 rows (106 beetles) with Etat Absent, flooded, torn, removed or Vide
notShipped.empty species columns: 31 species columns that hold no beetle in any row (a checklist template)
notShipped.species caught only by the other method: 3 species (AGONVIDU, POECVERS, SYNTFOVE) have no beetle in any pitfall collection, so this table's surveys did not record them (taxonInclusion = recorded)
notShipped.Carabus violaceus purpurascens: subspecies written in the column name, shipped as Carabus violaceus
